title: Transport of arbitrary constant coordinates on the condensed coefficient ring
statement: Let f:Y→X be any scheme morphism, Λ a commutative condensed ring, k any commutative ring in the coefficient universe, and c:constant(k)≅smallRing(X,Λ_X) with the conventions of [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data]. There exists a unique ring-sheaf isomorphism d:constant(k)≅smallRing(Y,Λ_Y) for which the section-ring coefficient map of [lem-sfb-internal-module-operations-transport] sends c(a) to d(a), for every constant section a and every test object V of the coefficient-sized site of X (the latter d(a) evaluated on the base change of V). This only transports ring coordinates: it asserts no module equivalence or slice or module pullback comparison. No nonzero-ring, nonempty-scheme or scalar-normalization hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Sites Tag 00YV; Modules on Sites Tag 03D2; ring-coordinate transport in step 1 of lem-sfb-constant-slice-module-encoding.

proof.text: Let κ:constant_X k→f_*constant_Y k be the unique extension of the constant-presheaf unit. Evaluating at a terminal object and its base change shows that its adjunct q:f^*constant_X k→constant_Y k is an isomorphism: both constant sheaf functors are left adjoints to the same terminal-section functor. This is proved by leftAdjointUniq and the sheafification Hom bijection.

Let φ=condensedSmallRingMap f Λ and ψ its adjunct. The ring-only coefficient pullback theorem makes ψ invertible. Define d=q⁻¹ followed by f^*(c) followed by ψ. Naturality of the adjunction gives κ followed by f_*(d)=c followed by φ. Precompose with the constant-presheaf unit and evaluate to obtain the displayed equation on constants.

Conversely the displayed equation on constants implies the full sheaf-morphism equation by the sheafification Hom bijection. Apply the inverse-image adjunction to that equation and cancel the isomorphism q to determine d.hom; Iso.ext then determines d. These are complete generic categorical calculations in Lean, with no module or slice assumptions.

proof_origin.place: G3 explicit constant-sheaf adjunction construction and uniqueness; the only assumed step is invertibility of the coordinate-free reconstructed coefficient ring adjunct.

theorem constant_coefficient_pullback_coordinates
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k]
    (c : ConstantCompletion.constant (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X) k ≅
      smallRing X (condensedRingObj Λ X)) :
    ∃! d : ConstantCompletion.constant (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y) k ≅
        smallRing Y (condensedRingObj Λ Y),
      ∀ (V : (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X)ᵒᵖ) (a : k),
        ((InternalModuleOperations.coefficientMap Λ f).hom.app
          (AsSmall.down.op.obj V)).hom
            (c.hom.hom.app V
              ((toSheafify (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X)
                ((Functor.const _).obj (CommRingCat.of k))).app V a)) =
          d.hom.hom.app ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelBaseChange.{u, u} f).op.obj V)
            ((toSheafify (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y)
              ((Functor.const _).obj (CommRingCat.of k))).app
                ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelBaseChange.{u, u} f).op.obj V) a)
